content: {"episode_id":"ep-05007","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"CPT 93229 mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered for a patient with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness (R42) in the setting of an unspecified cardiac arrhythmia (I49.9). The patient also has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction (Z86.73), and the monitoring was ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic causes. This documented clinical indication supports the medical necessity of the monitoring, and we request reconsideration of the CO-197 denial; the service is within the payer's 30-day retro-authorization consideration and this appeal is submitted 45 days after service, within the 135 days remaining to the filing deadline, for the outstanding balance of 820.46."}
